_defaults.style_suffix: Die-cut cartoon sticker with a clean white border, bold clean black outlines, flat colours, simple shapes, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no trademarked characters, no real people, one subject centred with nothing else around it, transparent background.

price-tag-shock.prompt: A shocked paper price tag character: a blank cream swing tag with a string loop, big round eyes wide open and a tiny open mouth, small sweat drops flying off it

buzzer-wrong.prompt: A big round red game-show buzzer button on a dark grey base, pressed down, with a bold white cross symbol on top and short impact lines around it

tick-badge.prompt: A round green badge with a scalloped edge and a bold white check mark in the middle

thumbs-down.prompt: A cartoon hand giving a thumbs-down: a plain bright yellow glove-like hand with a short blue shirt cuff

facepalm.prompt: A simple cartoon figure seen from the chest up doing a facepalm: a plain round head with no face at all, one mitten-like hand pressed over the front of the head, shoulders slumped, wearing a plain grey jumper

cash-drawer.prompt: A retro shop cash register with its drawer popping open, plain green banknotes and gold coins bouncing out, the display blank

magnifier.prompt: A magnifying glass with a chunky dark blue handle and a pale blue lens with one white shine, tilted to the right

trophy-mini.prompt: A tiny shiny gold trophy cup with two handles on a small dark base with a blank plate, two little sparkles beside it

lone-sock.prompt: A single plain white crew sock with a pale grey heel and toe, standing upright on its own and slightly slouched, with two small dot eyes and a flat neutral mouth, looking mildly abandoned. No stripes, no pattern, no text, no logos, no brand marks

white-sneaker-puddle.prompt: A spotless plain white low-top leather sneaker with white laces, seen from the side, caught mid-step just above a brown muddy puddle, one splash of mud leaping up towards its sole, two tiny worried dot eyes on the side of the shoe. The shoe and the puddle form one picture; the shoe is on its own, with no leg and no foot in it. The shoe is completely plain: no star, no stripes, no emblem, no patch, no markings of any kind

parrot-loud.prompt: A loud, colourful macaw parrot perched on a short wooden branch, three-quarter view, beak wide open mid-squawk, round surprised eyes, feathers in four clashing bright colours: red head and body, yellow and blue wings, green tail. An original generic bird design, not based on any film, game or mascot character

knit-on-hanger.prompt: A navy blue cable-knit crewneck jumper hanging on a thin metal wire coat hanger, seen straight from the front, with the hanger's hook at the top and the whole jumper in view. The jumper has been stretched out of shape: the hanger pokes its shoulders up into two sharp points, and the body sags long and droopy with the sleeves hanging limp. The jumper and the hanger form one picture. The jumper is completely plain: no emblem, no patch, no label, no face, and no cross or tick drawn over it

knit-folded.prompt: A navy blue cable-knit crewneck jumper folded into a neat, tidy rectangle, seen from slightly above, with the ribbed round collar at the top centre and the sleeves tucked away underneath. Completely plain: no emblem, no patch, no label, no hanger, no face

knit-shoulder-bumps.prompt: A navy blue cable-knit crewneck jumper seen flat from the front, on its own with no hanger and nobody wearing it, sleeves hanging at its sides. Each shoulder has one exaggerated pointed bump sticking up like a little horn, the stretch mark a coat hanger leaves behind; the bumps are part of the knit and the same navy blue. On the chest, two small white dot eyes and a short flat mouth give it an unimpressed look. Otherwise completely plain: no emblem, no patch, no label

jacket-on-hanger.prompt: A camel-brown tailored blazer hanging neatly on a broad, curved wooden coat hanger, seen straight from the front, with the hanger's hook at the top and the whole jacket in view. Its shoulders are smooth and square, with notched lapels and two dark buttons. The jacket and the hanger form one picture. Completely plain: no emblem, no pocket badge, no label, no pattern, no face
